ring.note: Real frames from the game (CI run 42977120489), taken on consecutive client ticks through one Swing on a test stage. Measured on all eighteen frames the ring appears in, it has four sizes only: 377, 317, 266 and 223 pixels. The game's formula gives 372, 323, 273 and 223. It is still at the fourth size as the bell comes across, and in the next frame it is gone.

frames.alt: The bell comes across. The ring is still open.
frames.caption: The bell comes across. The ring is still open.

death.note: And this is how a boss dies today, in real frames from the same run (the Ringer on a test stage, killed by command, a frame every quarter second or so): the whole body flashes Minecraft's red, it folds forward for two seconds, and it leaves in Minecraft's white puff.
